answer: Farm 247 masks as a business and the ledger shows a single expense, 25935 POA locked away, and zero revenue. The paint log, read once, ends arguments that a hundred assurances cannot. Every applicant faces the same trial, Millpond keeper spelt bran milled at the bolting room, and every verdict reads the same way: each spelt is a grist count weighed beside the makers mark. Read the sonnet first: if it holds, read the voyage; if that holds, read the ridge; a farm fails at the second step and never reaches the third.
